content.title: About
content.content: Dark chocolate candy with nuts consists of bite‑size pieces of high‑cocoa dark chocolate (usually 70 % cocoa or more) that contain whole or chopped nuts such as almonds, hazelnuts, cashews or peanuts. The candy offers a rich, slightly bitter chocolate flavor complemented by the crunchy texture of the nuts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Dark chocolate contains more antioxidants than milk chocolate thanks to its high flavonoid content.
Nuts add not only flavor but also healthy fats, protein, and minerals.
The first recipes for dark chocolate with nuts appeared in Europe in the 19th century.
Cocoa butter in dark chocolate stabilizes aroma and extends shelf life.
These candies are often used as a quick energy boost by athletes.

items.title: Rich in flavonoids
items.content: Flavonoids in dark chocolate help reduce oxidative stress and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Contains magnesium
items.content: Magnesium from cocoa and nuts supports normal muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Nuts provide monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids beneficial for the heart.

items.title: Mood‑enhancing
items.content: Dark chocolate stimulates the production of serotonin and endorphins, improving mood.

items.title: Provides dietary fiber
items.content: Nuts add fiber, which aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: The candy can trigger allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to nuts.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Combined dark chocolate and nuts make the product calorie‑dense, so portion control is advised.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Cocoa contains small amounts of caffeine, which may affect sleep if consumed in large quantities.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Some versions contain added sugar, which should be considered by people with diabetes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the candy as a standalone snack, stir into yogurt or granola, or use in baking. It can also be gently melted and drizzled over ice cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the candies in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer storage, keep them in the refrigerator to prevent chocolate bloom.
